title: TABLE TENNIS TOURNAMENT - SPECIALLY-ABLED CHILDREN
summary: What a Heart-touching and Emotionally fulfilling service project we witnessed today at Goregaon Sports Club! 512 Specially-abled children, 512 Smiles & a Table Tennis Tournament, filling the venue with enthusiasm, excitement and happiness!
description:
What a Heart-touching and Emotionally fulfilling service project we witnessed today at Goregaon Sports Club!

512 Specially-abled children, 512 Smiles & a Table Tennis Tournament, filling the venue with enthusiasm, excitement and happiness!
The joy and pride in their parents' eyes was deeply touching!
Every child was presented with a medal, making them feel Special, Appreciated and Encouraged, spreading confidence and happiness.

OUR HEARTFELT GRATITUDE TO:
IPDG Dr. Manish Motwani – Chief Guest.
Shri K. K. Ji – Our Mentor.
Shri Vinod Podar Ji – President, GSC.
OPK Joshua – Promoter Member GSC

Rtn. Chandramohan Dawar - Project Mentor. & Rtn. Shashi Chhachhia – Project In-charge for excellent arrangements, warm hospitality and wonderful poolside breakfast!

A BIG THANK YOU to our 25 Royales and their spouses, the GSC leadership and promoter members for making this initiative so special!
SERVICE ABOVE SELF – ALWAYS!
location: Goregaon Sports Club, Goregaon, Mumbai, Maharashtra
